enabled.label: Enable adaptive brightness
enabled.description: Turn the ambient-light adaptation on or off. While off, the panel is left completely alone.

connector.label: Output connector
connector.description: The display whose brightness is driven, e.g. eDP-1. Must match a Noctalia brightness target.

backlight.label: Backlight device
backlight.description: Leave empty to auto-detect the first device under /sys/class/backlight.

learning_profile.label: Apply the learned profile
learning_profile.description: On: apply the curve learned from your brightness changes instead of the node lists below. Off: apply your node lists. Either way the plugin keeps recording, so switching this on shows a profile that has been developing rather than an empty one. Useful while working out an initial curve. The learned profile is a file (profile.json) in the plugin data directory; this settings page cannot be written by the plugin itself, so promoting a learned value into the nodes below is a manual copy.

curve_brightness.label: Brightness curve (sensor counts : percent)
curve_brightness.description: One node per row, written as sensor-reading:brightness-percent. Values between nodes are joined with a smooth curve that is guaranteed never to overshoot the two nodes it sits between, so the panel stays inside the band you draw. Ten nodes are supplied as a starting point; add, remove or reorder rows freely. A '#' starts a comment. Readings are raw sensor counts, not lux, because this sensor's absolute calibration is unverified.

curve_temperature.label: Colour temperature curve (ambient K : panel K)
curve_temperature.description: One node per row, written as ambient-kelvin:panel-kelvin. Lower panel values are warmer. Only used when adaptive colour temperature is enabled below. Ten nodes are supplied: flat at 5100 K below a 3000 K room, rising to 6500 K by 5500 K.

min_percent.label: Minimum brightness (%)
min_percent.description: Hard floor, so a dark or occluded reading can never drive the panel to an unreadable level.

max_percent.label: Maximum brightness (%)
max_percent.description: Hard ceiling for the adapted brightness.

colortemp.label: Adaptive colour temperature
colortemp.description: Also warm the panel toward the ambient colour temperature, driving Noctalia's own night light. Off by default. WARNING: enabling this turns night light on in forced mode and rewrites temperature_night in settings.toml, which overrides any day/night schedule you configured.
